summary: Edgemode, Inc. disclosed a non-binding offer from Spark AI Foundry Holdings LLC to acquire 100% of DC Estate Malpica, S.L., a special purpose vehicle holding an in-development data center project in Mora, Spain. The offer is non-binding, subject to due diligence and definitive documentation, with a 60-day exclusivity period. The registrant also entered into 30-day standstill agreements with lenders holding $1.15M in convertible notes, prohibiting conversion or share disposition. No deal terms were stated. This is an early-stage divestiture with limited certainty; watch for execution of a definitive purchase agreement and regulatory steps.
